ignoreCommand: bash -c 'message=$(printf "%s" "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE"); printf "%s" "$message" | grep -Eiq "\[(skip ci|ci skip|no ci|skip actions|actions skip)\]|(^|[[:space:]])skip-checks:[[:space:]]*true([[:space:]]|$)" && exit 0; git diff HEAD~1 --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "^(web/|vercel\.json|\.vercelignore|next\.config)" && exit 1; exit 0'
